narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.content: I was tracing the nightly batch logs and saw that the move from ingestion to validation is not automatic. The transition only happens when a user sends a manual request to kick off the validation step. I see this pattern repeating across the last few weeks of run history. The ingestion completes, but the data sits idle until someone triggers the next stage. It is a consistent behavior in the current setup.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes a consistent, observed behavior in the system logs without expressing any wish, refusal, trade-off, or specific need for change.
